items.q: And she, this person, Mrs. Regina, had an idea of getting Mitchell

ctx.x: Well, Louie, poor Louie, the race course meant him no good at all. He finally -- didn't go broke, but he borrowed money from a lady who had a hotel on the Rue Pigalle.
And she, this person, Mrs. Regina, had an idea of getting Mitchell, and his wife, to open a cabaret in her place, that's why she --
